backup.production_rule: Re-creates public.fn_direct_booking_cascade() with one changed where-clause: a voided direct-booking income row now cancels the calendar rows 'direct:<id>' and 'cascade-direct-<id>' (before: only the first). It stops (55000) unless the live body is the 20261008100000 one or this one. It also adds the BEFORE trigger trg_guard_direct_booking_income_void: voiding the income row of a CONFIRMED direct booking is refused (42501) unless the signed-in user has manage_booking (owner or admin); the service role is refused too. No table, column, existing trigger or stored row changes; calendar rows left confirmed by an earlier void are not repaired.
backup.notes: restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: restamp them with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs). record_offline_booking_20261211 is a separate release with an older timestamp that does not touch this function: apply it first, or the CLI will see 20261211 as out of order.

forward_verification.name: cascade_body_is_the_new_one
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '6df13b3b647844b6b7d76d5d12835393' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.fn_direct_booking_cascade()'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: cascade_is_definer_with_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.fn_direct_booking_cascade()'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: no_client_role_executes_the_cascade
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.fn_direct_booking_cascade()', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.fn_direct_booking_cascade()', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.fn_direct_booking_cascade()', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: cascade_trigger_is_still_attached
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_trigger where tgrelid = 'public.transactions'::regclass and tgname = 'trg_direct_booking_cascade' and tgenabled = 'O'

forward_verification.name: void_guard_is_a_before_trigger
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_trigger where tgrelid = 'public.transactions'::regclass and tgname = 'trg_guard_direct_booking_income_void' and tgenabled = 'O' and pg_get_triggerdef(oid) like '%BEFORE UPDATE OF status%'

forward_verification.name: void_guard_is_closed_and_definer
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""'] and not has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', p.oid, 'execute') from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.guard_direct_booking_income_void()'::regprocedure

rollback.safe_until: any time; it drops the void guard and restores the previous function body

feature_flags.name: no_flag_database_triggers_only
feature_flags.required_state: None. No caller or edge function changes: telegram-expense (waves branch) voids expenses only, through telegram_expense_review_v1, which answers locked for a direct_booking row.

compatibility.evidence: Not rehearsed yet with the guard. Not applied to production.

the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
